knowledge:
- key_parameters: <min.ntx=minimum number of transcripts a gene must have to be kept in SplicingGraphs (default is 2) ;; tx_id.as.edge.label=logical flag in sgraph() to label edges with transcript IDs ;; with.hits.mcols=logical flag in sgedgesByTranscript() to include read assignment hit columns ;; reads=GAlignmentPairs or GAlignments object in plotTranscripts() to plot reads alongside transcripts ;; from/to=genomic coordinates in plotTranscripts() to zoom into a specific region>
- alternatives: <readGAlignmentPairs vs readGAlignments: readGAlignmentPairs must be used for paired-end data to ensure proper pairing of BAM records, otherwise they remain unpaired in a GAlignments object>
- when_to_use: <Use this package when you want to analyze alternative splicing events as directed acyclic graphs, identify and classify splicing bubbles (e.g., exon skipping, alternative donors/acceptors), and quantify RNA-seq read support directly on individual splicing graph edges (exons and introns).>
- pitfalls: <Splicing graphs cannot describe trans-splicing events because they require all exons of all transcripts of a gene to be on the same chromosome and strand ;; sgedges() and sgnodes() only work on a SplicingGraphs object of length 1 (use single-bracket subsetting like sg["gene_id"] first) ;; unlisting a SplicingGraphs object with unlist() yields non-unique names (gene IDs), so subsetting by name directly (e.g., ex_by_tx["3183"]) only selects the first match; use x[names(x) %in% c(...)] instead ;; aligned reads and the gene model (TxDb) must be based on the exact same reference genome assembly>

workflows.name: splicing_graph_and_read_quantification
workflows.intent: Construct splicing graphs from a gene model, identify alternative splicing bubbles, assign aligned RNA-seq reads to graph edges, and generate a read count matrix.
input: txdb (TxDb object representing the gene model)
bam_files (BAM files containing aligned RNA-seq reads)
workflows.stages: 1. Filter active sequences in the gene model ;; 2. Construct the SplicingGraphs object using SplicingGraphs() ;; 3. Extract and visualize splicing graph edges and nodes using sgedges(), sgnodes(), and sgraph() ;; 4. Identify and classify alternative splicing bubbles using bubbles() ;; 5. Load paired-end RNA-seq reads using readGAlignmentPairs() ;; 6. Assign reads to splicing graph edges using assignReads() ;; 7. Extract detailed read assignments using sgedgesByTranscript() ;; 8. Summarize read counts per edge using countReads()
workflows.code:
library(TxDb.Hsapiens.UCSC.hg19.refGene)
txdb <- TxDb.Hsapiens.UCSC.hg19.refGene
isActiveSeq(txdb)[-match("chr14", names(isActiveSeq(txdb)))] <- FALSE
library(SplicingGraphs)
sg <- SplicingGraphs(txdb)
sg[["3183"]]
mcols(sg[["3183"]])
txpath(sg[["3183"]])
plotTranscripts(sg[["3183"]])
ex_by_tx <- unlist(sg)
sg["3183"]
sgedges(sg["3183"])
sgnodes(sg["3183"])
edges_by_gene <- sgedgesByGene(sg)
plot(sgraph(sg["3183"]))
plot(sgraph(sg["3183"], tx_id.as.edge.label=TRUE))
bubbles(sg["115801414"])
library(RNAseqData.HNRNPC.bam.chr14)
bam_files <- RNAseqData.HNRNPC.bam.chr14_BAMFILES
flag0 <- scanBamFlag(isSecondaryAlignment=FALSE, isNotPassingQualityControls=FALSE, isDuplicate=FALSE)
param0 <- ScanBamParam(flag=flag0)
for (i in seq_along(bam_files)) {
    bam_file <- bam_files[i]
    gapairs <- readGAlignmentPairs(bam_file, use.names=TRUE, param=param0)
    sg <- assignReads(sg, gapairs, sample.name=names(bam_file))
}
edges_by_tx <- sgedgesByTranscript(sg["3183"], with.hits.mcols=TRUE)
plotTranscripts(sg[["3183"]], reads=junction_reads, from=21675000, to=21702000)
sg_counts <- countReads(sg)
